verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's own marketing says it automates routine work and moves cases between agents and the team. Its docs say workflows can be configured to mirror an organization's policies, which is a thin, glancing basis for policy-bounded automation with human handoff. Nothing documents policy limits on automatic remediation or criteria for escalating ambiguous or high-risk findings to a human. Missing for 10: documented policy controls limiting automated actions, explicit escalation rules for ambiguous or high-risk findings, configuration docs for agent-to-human handoff, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can limit automatic remediation by policy and escalate ambiguous or high-risk findings to a human

citations.quote: It automates routine work, moves cases between agents and your team, and keeps every decision defensible.
We can easily configure your Hummingbird account with workflows that mirror your policies.
